# Deep Dive: Currency Interventions and Energy Updates

Report 141 | Published 2024-07-21 | Evaluated 2026-11-07

[Original member article](https://www.lynalden.com/premium-2024-7-21/) | [Article index](README.md) | [Structured review](../data/reviews/141.json)

Currency policy, energy, and rotation scenarios.

The near-term Treasury borrowing call clearly missed, while 2025 runoff cessation and the ETF/policy event calls held. Energy and rotation reasoning was materially less precise: organic international service growth weakened and oil prices fell during 2025. Numerous scenario and valuation propositions require definitions before binary scoring. The 2020 currency excerpt is explanatory reuse, not independent forecast evidence.

**Coverage:** All source blocks and chart labels read. Covers liquidity, households, fiscal/election scenarios, currency mechanisms, digital assets, energy businesses, and equity rotation. Historical 2020 excerpt is not a new forecast. Excludes boilerplate and bare position lists.
